    • inner

      public Rect inner(Rect area)
      Returns the inner area after applying this margin.

      The returned rect is inset by the margin values on each side. If the margin would result in negative dimensions, returns an empty rect.

      Parameters:
      area - the outer area
      Returns:
      the inner area with margin applied
